name: open-historia-mobile
description: Open Historia for Android: the web build inside a Capacitor WebView with everything on the device — the library in IndexedDB, the world map inside the APK (npm run map fetches and verifies it), files saved through the share sheet, a LAN model reached through native HTTP. The community hub and the player's own AI provider are the only network use.

scripts.apk: npm run map && npm run www && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
